meta_title: PNG to WebP Converter: Keep Transparency | Resize-It
meta_description: Convert PNG to WebP and keep transparent backgrounds. Much smaller files for websites. Batch convert in your browser, no uploads.
subtitle: Shrink PNG images for your website while keeping transparent backgrounds. Convert one file or many, all processed on your own device.

tool_workspace.description: Drop one or more PNG files below, then click Convert Image.
features_list: Runs in your browser: no uploads

requirements.intro: PNG is lossless, which makes files large. WebP supports transparency too, so a logo or cut-out image keeps its transparent background but usually becomes much smaller.

rows.label: Compression
rows.value: PNG: Lossless: pixels are stored exactly. WebP: Lossy or lossless (this tool saves lossy WebP at 90% quality).

rows.label: Transparency
rows.value: PNG: Yes, full transparency. WebP: Yes, including in lossy mode.

rows.label: Best for
rows.value: PNG: Screenshots, logos, graphics with text or sharp edges, images that need a transparent background. WebP: Images on websites, where smaller files load faster.

rows.label: Compatibility
rows.value: PNG: Opens everywhere. WebP: All current browsers. Some older desktop software and some upload forms still reject WebP.

requirements.notes_h3: Before you convert PNG to WebP
notes: Transparency is kept: transparent areas in the PNG stay transparent in the WebP.
This tool saves lossy WebP at 90% quality, which gives the biggest savings. For screenshots with small text, check the result looks sharp enough.
Good for: website logos, icons, product cut-outs and illustrations.
Keep the PNG as your master copy if you will edit the image again.

how_to.title: How to convert PNG to WebP
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more PNG files. They are read in your browser, not uploaded.
how_to.step2_text: WebP is already selected on this page. You can switch to another format if needed.
how_to.step3_text: Click Convert Image. Each image is redrawn and saved in the new format on your device.
how_to.step4_text: A single image downloads directly; several images download together as a ZIP.

items.q: Does PNG to WebP keep a transparent background?
items.a: Yes. WebP supports transparency, and transparent pixels in your PNG stay transparent.
Slightly. The tool saves WebP at 90% quality, which is usually hard to tell apart from the original but much smaller.
